name: mqtt-smarthome cover
description: A position item (0 = closed … full scale = open) as a window covering; a controller's position is scaled and published, stop is not sent.

instance.label: Instance name
instance.description: The adapter instance's <name>: the first level of its topics (lgtv, hm, cul, …)

item.label: Item
item.description: The position item below status/ and set/, e.g. blind/1/level

max.label: Full scale
max.description: The value the item reports for 100 % (100, 1, 255, …)

status.template: {{ 100 - ((value_json.val if value_json is mapping else value) | float) * 100 / %max% }}

command.template: {% set v = open * %max% / 100 %}{{ v | int if v == v | int else v | round(3) }}
